newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open off 0.30 to 0.70 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open off 0.30 to 0.70 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open down 0.30 to 0.70 cent per pound Tuesday, as LME three months eased to just above $2,450 a tonne support and the backwardation shrank.
LME stocks fell a modest 475 tonnes Tuesday to 141,100 tonnes.
On overnight ACCESS COMEX July copper was traded 115.80 to 115.15, compared with Monday's close of 115.85 cents.
The LME backwardation was $52, down from about $70 on Monday.
